briefdescription.para: Used to wait in polled function.
IBI data segment size in Dwords.
Checks for the error that a target stuck after an overflow produces.
Tests a command word for a private transfer or a directed CCC.

detaileddescription.para: Address assignment and broadcast CCCs are excluded because they do not address one target.

briefdescription.para: Lists the dynamic addresses available for I3C devices.
Programs the IBI defaults.

detaileddescription.para: It rejects all Slave-Interrupt (SIR), Master-Request (MR) and Hot-Join events, and sets the IBI status queue threshold so that a single IBI generates an interrupt. Individual targets are later opted in with XI3cPsx_EnableIbi(); Hot-Join is opted in with XI3cPsx_EnableHotJoin().

simplesect.para: The IBI threshold interrupt itself is not enabled here; it is enabled lazily when the first target's IBI (or Hot-Join) is enabled.

briefdescription.para: Captures the BCR of every enumerated target into the instance.

detaileddescription.para: Captures the Bus Characteristic Register (BCR) of every enumerated target from the Device Characteristic Table (DCT) into the driver instance. The BCR is used to determine whether a target appends a mandatory data byte to its IBI.

simplesect.para: Call after a successful ENTDAA so the DCT is populated.

briefdescription.para: Services the IBI threshold interrupt.

detaileddescription.para: It drains every queued IBI status entry, decodes the IBI type, and for a Slave-Interrupt (SIR) reads the payload and dispatches it to the registered IBI handler.

briefdescription.para: Drains and discards Len bytes of IBI payload from the IBI queue port.

detaileddescription.para: Used for IBI types the driver does not handle.

briefdescription.para: Reads an IBI payload from the IBI queue port.

detaileddescription.para: It pops ceil(QueueLen/4) words so the whole payload is removed from the queue, but copies at most CopyLen bytes into Buf. Reading the full queue length even when CopyLen is smaller keeps the IBI queue from desynchronising.

parameterdescription.para: The maximum number of payload bytes to copy to Buf.
The number of payload bytes present in the queue.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes copied into Buf.

briefdescription.para: Sends a direct ENEC or DISEC CCC to a single target.

detaileddescription.para: Sends a direct ENEC or DISEC CCC to a single target to enable or disable its Slave-Interrupt (SIR) event generation.

parameterdescription.para: The Device Address Table index of the target.
TRUE to send ENEC(SIR), FALSE to send DISEC(SIR).

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the CCC completed without error.
XST_SEND_ERROR if the payload could not be sent.
XST_TIMEOUT if the ISR never signaled completion.
XST_FAILURE if the CCC completed with a bus-level error.

briefdescription.para: Returns whether the controller rejects Hot-Join requests.

detaileddescription.para: Returns whether Hot-Join requests are currently rejected at the controller (DEVICE_CTRL.HOT_JOIN_CTRL).

simplesect.para: 1 if Hot-Join is rejected, 0 if it is accepted.

briefdescription.para: Clears an error a target latched during an earlier transfer.

detaileddescription.para: The target's CCC_DEVICE_STATUS is read only, and OVERFLOW_ERR is cleared only when the controller reads that register with a GETSTATUS CCC. Until the read happens the target will not acknowledge its dynamic address, and nothing the target's own software can do will help.

parameterdescription.para: Device address table index of the target.

briefdescription.para: Frees a target that has stopped acknowledging.

detaileddescription.para: The master is unhalted and its FIFOs cleared before the CCC goes out. The error response halts the master too, so an untouched master never sends the GETSTATUS, and resetting the FIFOs of a halted core leaves it halted. RESUME alone leaves an untransmitted word behind that misaligns the next transfer. The failing target is the one named by the last command written.

briefdescription.para: Sends dynamic Address Assignment for available devices.

parameterdescription.para: The number of slave devices present.

briefdescription.para: Initializes the I3C bus.

detaileddescription.para: It configures the device address table, then resets and assigns the dynamic address to the slave devices.

simplesect.para: SCL timing must be programmed before calling this function. Call XI3cPsx_SetSClk() or XI3cPsx_SetSClkRate() first so that the RSTDAA and ENTDAA bus transactions issued here run at the intended clock rate. XI3cPsx_CfgInitialize() handles this sequence automatically; callers invoking XI3cPsx_BusInit() directly are responsible for calling XI3cPsx_SetSClk() first.

briefdescription.para: Initiates an interrupt-driven send in master mode.

detaileddescription.para: It tries to send the first FIFO-full of data, then lets the interrupt handler to handle the rest of the data if there is any.

parameterdescription.para: The number of bytes to be sent.

simplesect.para: This send routine is for interrupt-driven transfer only.

briefdescription.para: Initiates an interrupt-driven receive in master mode.

detaileddescription.para: It sets the transfer size register so the slave can send data to us. The rest of the work is managed by interrupt handler.

parameterdescription.para: The number of bytes to be received.

simplesect.para: This receive routine is for interrupt-driven transfer only.

briefdescription.para: Initiates a polled mode send in master mode.

detaileddescription.para: It sends data to the FIFO and waits for the slave to pick them up. If master fails to send data due arbitration lost, stops the transfer and with arbitration lost status If slave fails to remove data from FIFO, the send fails with time out.

parameterdescription.para: The number of bytes to be sent.

simplesect.para: This send routine is for polled mode transfer only. All the FIFO operations are in terms of words.

briefdescription.para: Initiates a polled mode receive in master mode.

detaileddescription.para: It repeatedly sets the transfer size register so the slave can send data to us. It polls the data register for data to come in. If master fails to read data due arbitration lost, returns with arbitration lost status. If slave fails to send us data, it fails with time out.

parameterdescription.para: The number of bytes to be received.

simplesect.para: This receive routine is for polled mode transfer only.

briefdescription.para: Sets the status handler for the driver.

detaileddescription.para: The driver calls the handler when it encounters conditions that should be reported to the higher layer software. The handler executes in an interrupt context, so the amount of processing should be minimized.

parameterdescription.para: The callback reference passed to the handler.

simplesect.para: The handler is called within interrupt context, so it should finish its work quickly.

briefdescription.para: Handles interrupts in master mode.

detaileddescription.para: It does the protocol handling for the interrupt-driven transfers.

If the Master is receiving data then the data is read from the FIFO and the Master has to request for more data (if there is more data to receive). If all the data has been received then a completion event is signalled to the upper layer by calling the callback handler. It is an error if the amount of received data is more than expected.

briefdescription.para: Sets the IBI (SIR) handler.

detaileddescription.para: The driver calls the handler from interrupt context when an In-Band Interrupt is received from a target.

parameterdescription.para: The upper-layer callback reference, passed back to the handler when it is invoked.
Pointer to the IBI callback function.

simplesect.para: The handler runs in interrupt context and must copy the payload out immediately; the payload buffer is reused on the next IBI.

briefdescription.para: Enables In-Band Interrupt (SIR) reception for a single target.

detaileddescription.para: It clears the SIR reject in the target's DAT entry and in the global reject register, sets IBI-with-data if the target's BCR advertises a mandatory data byte, lazily enables the IBI threshold interrupt, and sends ENEC(SIR) to the target.

parameterdescription.para: The Device Address Table index of the target (same index used during dynamic address assignment).

listitem.para: XST_SEND_ERROR if the ENEC(SIR) payload could not be sent.
XST_TIMEOUT if the IBI queue reset or the ENEC(SIR) response never completed.

briefdescription.para: Disables In-Band Interrupt (SIR) reception for a single target.

detaileddescription.para: It sends DISEC(SIR) to the target, sets the SIR reject in both the DAT entry and the global reject register, and disables the IBI threshold interrupt if no targets remain armed.

parameterdescription.para: The Device Address Table index of the target.

listitem.para: XST_SEND_ERROR if the DISEC(SIR) payload could not be sent.
XST_TIMEOUT if the DISEC(SIR) response never completed.

briefdescription.para: Enables Hot-Join request acceptance.

detaileddescription.para: It clears DEVICE_CTRL.HOT_JOIN_CTRL so the controller ACKs a Hot-Join request, and lazily enables the IBI threshold interrupt (shared with SIR) since Hot-Join requests are reported through the same IBI queue.

simplesect.para: A Hot-Join sets HotJoinPending and invokes the Hot-Join handler from the ISR. The blocking ENTDAA enrolment is deferred: the application must call XI3cPsx_HotJoinDaa() from thread context to assign the new target its dynamic address.

briefdescription.para: Disables Hot-Join request acceptance.

detaileddescription.para: It sets DEVICE_CTRL.HOT_JOIN_CTRL so the controller NACKs a Hot-Join request, and disables the IBI threshold interrupt if no SIR target remains armed either.

briefdescription.para: Sets the Hot-Join notification handler.

detaileddescription.para: The driver calls the handler from interrupt context to flag a Hot-Join request. The joining target is NOT yet enrolled when the handler runs; the application must run enrolment (ENTDAA) via XI3cPsx_HotJoinDaa() from thread context.

parameterdescription.para: The upper-layer callback reference, passed back to the handler when it is invoked.
Pointer to the Hot-Join callback function.

simplesect.para: The handler runs in interrupt context, so its work should be minimized (for example record the event and return).

briefdescription.para: Services a Hot-Join request by re-running ENTDAA.

detaileddescription.para: Services a Hot-Join request by re-running ENTDAA (without RSTDAA, so existing targets keep their address) and refreshing the captured BCR of every enumerated target on success.

simplesect.para: Must be called from thread (non-interrupt) context - for example from the application after a Hot-Join notification. The ISR only flags the Hot-Join via HotJoinPending. The ENTDAA is issued interrupt-driven so the live ISR is the single response consumer; a polled send would race the ISR (which clears the response first) and time out.

briefdescription.para: Returns the number of IBI status entries currently queued.

simplesect.para: Number of queued IBI status entries.

briefdescription.para: Implements I3C master transfer APIs.
